name: save-bar
purpose: The bar at the bottom of a settings or create page that holds the status of unsaved work and its Discard (or Cancel) and Save actions. `floating` overlays the bottom of the scroll region without moving the content and is shown while the form is dirty; `docked` takes its own row at the bottom; `plain` closes a form column saved as one unit, always shown; `fade` closes a wizard step with no border or surface, the step content fading into the canvas above Back and Next.
useWhen: A settings page whose changes are staged and saved together: show the floating bar while the form is dirty or saving.
A create page or account form with one Save for the whole page (`plain`).
A full-page wizard step: Back in `leading`, the step's primary action in `actions` (`fade`).
avoidWhen: A card that saves on its own → put the actions in the card footer.
A drawer or dialog form → use the `PanelFooter` of `drawer` or `dialog`.
related: button` — the actions: an outlined Discard or Cancel, then a primary Save with `loading` while it runs.
settings-section` — the bands the bar saves.
confirm-dialog` — the guard shown when someone leaves with unsaved changes.
bestPractices: Render the floating bar with `v-if="dirty || saving"` inside a `Transition`, so it slides in when the first change is made.
Say what changed and when it takes effect in the status sentence; keep it to one line.
Disable Discard and set `loading` on Save while saving.

props.name: kind
props.doc: How the bar sits at the bottom of its scroll region.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The status sentence on the left, such as You have unsaved changes.

slots.name: leading
slots.notes: Replaces the whole leading region (the info icon and the sentence) with your own content, such as a `StatusIndicator` (Saving…, Saved) or an unsaved-changes count. Takes precedence over `default`.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Discard or Cancel, then Save, on the right.

examples.name: Floating
Docked
Plain
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import SaveBar from '@aziontech/webkit/save-bar'
</script>

<template>
  <SaveBar kind="plain">
    <template #actions>
      <Button
        type="button"
        label="Cancel"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
      <Button
        label="Save"
        kind="primary"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </SaveBar>
</template>
